0.75.1

November 18, 2026Stable

Readable downloads and Gmail previews you can actually use.

4 fixed

Fixed

  • The sidebar downloads list opens from anywhere on its button, including the badge, and stays open while you move into it. It sits on the sidebar's own background, hiding the tabs behind it and fading into the rest of the sidebar, so file names are readable.
  • Gmail and Calendar favorite previews stay open while you move into them, so you can scroll, open a message or click + to compose. The favorite's title tooltip no longer covers them, and Gmail previews have a solid background.
  • While the pointer is in the downloads list or a preview, tabs, favorites and page links behind it no longer highlight or change the cursor, and scrolling stays in the preview.
  • Clicking a message in a Gmail preview opens that conversation instead of the inbox or an error page; messages highlight under the pointer and the + button for a new message is clearly visible.

0.75.0

November 18, 2026Stable

Search right from the sidebar address, encrypted iCloud sync and a cleaner way to clear site data.

7 new · 8 faster · 14 fixed · 1 smaller

New

  • Clicking the address in the sidebar opens a compact command bar right over it, with the current address selected. Type a search or a new address and press Return to load it in the same tab, or press Tab to search the suggested site.
  • When Circa starts and the restored window has no open tab, the New Tab search opens right away, focused and ready to type. Press Escape to keep the empty page.
  • Sync passwords is a separate switch under Settings › General. It is off on new setups and stays on if you already synced; turning it off stops password sync on this Mac and leaves the copies already in iCloud.
  • Clear Site Data for This Profile… removes cookies, cache, local storage, IndexedDB and service workers for that profile only; history, passwords and site permissions stay. Clearing one site's data also works when no tab shows that site.
  • Private windows are hidden from window captures by other apps.
  • Every profile now sends Global Privacy Control, asking sites not to sell or share your data.
  • The app icon you choose in Settings › Appearance stays in the Dock when Circa is not running, as long as Circa is kept in the Dock.

Faster

  • Library history search no longer blocks visit recording or sync: searching 200,000 visits for a common word takes 18.5 ms → 1.8 ms, and for a site name 62 ms → 0.8 ms.
  • History sync writes only what changed: about 33 KB per sync instead of rewriting about 160 MB for a 200,000-visit history (disk write per cycle 2.7 s → 2 ms).
  • Retyping a letter you just deleted shows search suggestions in 275–306 ms → 2–4 ms.
  • While the assistant writes, each new word costs 24 ms → 1.0 ms of main-thread time on a 30-message conversation (peaks 52–134 ms → 1.2 ms).
  • Opening the assistant panel on a 120 Hz display draws 20 → 47 frames, with no frozen frames.
  • Toggling a site permission costs 9.1 ms → 0.007 ms on the main thread.
  • Refreshing 100 sidebar rows without a cached icon takes 3 ms → 0.1 ms.
  • Session saves during sustained activity: 6.3 → 1.1 per second.

Fixed

  • With nothing typed, the command bar lists your open tabs and favorites first, followed by the keyboard shortcuts help; searching for exactly what you typed comes right after the top suggestion.
  • Spaces, tabs, settings and history now sync end-to-end encrypted in iCloud, like passwords already did.
  • Deleting a password no longer leaves its secret in the sync record that tells other Macs to delete it.
  • Turning iCloud sync off deletes its local caches.
  • Deleting history for a time range, a site or a single visit also removes it from the engine's own history.
  • Links opened with ⌘-click, ⌥-click into a split, ⇧-click into Peek, or Open Link in New Tab / Split View keep their originating page, so sites no longer receive their strict same-site cookies on cross-site opens.
  • Tabs opened in the background with ⌘-click no longer appear blank when you select them.
  • Browser-internal debug pages and javascript: addresses can no longer be loaded from session restore, AppleScript, link routing or other apps, and AppleScript can no longer run JavaScript in a private window.
  • Link routing rules match only a link's site and path; links opened from other apps have embedded user names and passwords removed.
  • Link previews refuse local-network and private addresses, including after redirects; update checks no longer send cookies.
  • Removing a profile also deletes its web cache and cookie backups, and resumes that cleanup after an interruption. Clearing one site's data also removes its cookies from migration backups.
  • Circa no longer writes inside its own app bundle, so its code signature stays valid; macOS no longer keeps its own snapshots of browser windows.
  • The Safe Browsing key no longer stays in the environment of processes Circa starts later, and password exports read during an import stay in memory.
  • Assistant animations, the Today sidebar accessory and palette transitions follow the display's refresh rate; Space switches no longer write settings during the swipe.

Smaller

  • Refreshed the bundled ad and tracker blocking lists.

Known limits

  • An older Circa cannot read the newly encrypted sync records until it updates; going back manually to 0.74.0 leaves history unavailable (not deleted) until the next update.
  • Command-L still opens the centered command bar, and the compact bar over the address appears without an animation.
  • Finder keeps showing the default app icon; the Dock may only pick up the chosen icon after the next login.
  • The engine deletes a URL's visits for a whole day, so deleting one visit can remove other visits of that URL the same day from the engine's history; history deletions received from another Mac are not yet removed from it.

Engine / bundled components: Chromium 158.0.8127.37; maintained engine r24; EasyList / EasyPrivacy pin fd7771846bc3bed3b5b6225de036652542817789

Release permalink ↗

0.75.0-nightly.1

November 16, 2026Nightly

Clear a whole profile's website data, and search history faster.

1 new · 3 faster · 9 fixed

New

  • Clear Site Data for This Profile… now works with the Chromium engine. It removes cookies, cache, local storage, IndexedDB and service workers for that profile only; history, passwords and site permissions stay. Clearing one site's data also works when no tab shows that site.

Faster

  • Library history search no longer blocks visit recording or sync: searching 200,000 visits for a common word takes 18.5 ms → 1.8 ms, and for a site name 62 ms → 0.8 ms.
  • While the assistant writes, each new word costs 24 ms → 1.0 ms of main-thread time on a 30-message conversation (peaks 52–134 ms → 1.2 ms).
  • Opening the assistant panel on a 120 Hz display draws 20 → 47 frames, with no frozen frames.

Fixed

  • Links opened with ⌘-click, ⌥-click into a split or ⇧-click into Peek now keep their originating page: sites see where the click came from, and their strict same-site cookies are no longer sent on cross-site opens.
  • Browser-internal debug pages and javascript: addresses can no longer be loaded from session restore, AppleScript, link routing or other apps.
  • AppleScript can no longer run JavaScript in a private window by setting a tab's URL to javascript:.
  • Link routing rules now match only a link's site and path, so a rule cannot be triggered by text in the query string.
  • Links opened from other apps have embedded user names and passwords removed.
  • Removing a profile now also deletes its web cache and its cookie backups.
  • Link previews refuse local-network and private addresses, including after redirects.
  • Update checks no longer send cookies.
  • Assistant animations, the Today sidebar accessory and palette transitions follow the display's refresh rate.

Known limits

  • Clearing one site's data does not remove that site's cookies from migration backups; they expire within 30 days.
  • The context menu commands Open Link in New Tab and Open Link in Split View still drop the originating page.
  • Going back manually to 0.74.0 leaves history unavailable (not deleted) until the next update.
Release permalink ↗

0.73.0

November 15, 2026Stable

Live Calendar, a sidebar on either side, an optional toolbar and faster everyday tab handling.

10 new · 7 fixed

New

  • Live Calendar (experimental): hover a Google Calendar Favorite to see today's schedule with real event lengths, and the tile counts down to your next meeting. Before a meeting, a reminder with a Join button (Google Meet, Zoom, Teams) appears under your Favorites, with a chime; choose 2, 5 or 10 minutes before, or never, from the Favorite's menu. When Circa is in the background, a macOS notification appears instead. Turn the sound off in Settings > Meeting reminder sound. It uses your existing Google sign-in in that profile; nothing is stored.
  • The sidebar can sit on the right: View > Sidebar on Right or Settings > Appearance. Window controls move with it.
  • Show an optional toolbar with back, forward, reload, the page address and your pinned extensions: View > Show Toolbar (Shift-Command-D), or Show as Toolbar from the sidebar address menu. It follows the page tint, and can show the full URL.
  • Search Settings with Command-F. Typos are forgiven, and choosing a result takes you straight to the option.
  • Search a site straight from the Command Bar with bang shortcuts like !gh, !w or !yt, before or after your query. Your own Site Search shortcuts work too.
  • Closing a tab now returns to the tab you used before it. Links open right below their tab, and Back on a link-opened tab with no history closes it and returns to the opener.
  • Close a sidebar tab with a middle click; on a pinned tab it removes the pin. Shift-Command-T brings it back.
  • Favorites show an unread dot for any web app that puts a count in its page title, not only Gmail. Right-click a Favorite to hide it.
  • Leaving Circa while a video plays moves it to picture-in-picture at the window's top-right; switching back to its tab brings it back inline. Hiding or minimising the window does not trigger it.
  • The sidebar media card gains mute, a progress bar with seeking and a picture-in-picture button, and works on muted tabs too.

Fixed

  • Ad and tracker blocking no longer changes files inside the app, preserving its security signature after browsing, and works when your account cannot modify the app.
  • The Library (Downloads, Media, Spaces, Boosts, Archived Tabs) uses the Space theme's text colour instead of dark text on dark themes, and the download status line keeps the state and size visible.
  • Menu commands remain available after typing an accent dead key or using an input method, including keyboard and accessibility activation.
  • In WebKit tabs, Back and Forward across History API entries update the address field.
  • Removing a profile no longer crashes the browser when no WebKit page was opened.
  • Translation checks on restored pages no longer repeatedly open and close the system language service on macOS 27.
  • Link summaries are more reliable when the app is busy.

Known limits

  • Live Calendar shows only the primary calendar; regular recurring events show their start time only and have no Join button; meetings you declined still get a reminder.
  • The media card cannot control media inside cross-origin frames or audio not attached to the page; per-tab volume, and previous / next on a muted tab, are not available yet.
  • Middle-click does not close Favorites or folders.
Release permalink ↗

0.71.2

November 15, 2026Stable

Security and privacy fixes with less battery use.

3 faster · 4 fixed

Faster

  • iCloud sync no longer checks in every 5 seconds. It runs when something changes, when iCloud pushes a change, when you come back to Circa, and every 10 minutes as a safety net. At idle, forced disk flushes drop from about 2 every 5 seconds → 0 between two 10-minute safety checks, saving battery and disk writes. A change made on another Mac can take up to 10 minutes to arrive if its push notification is missed.
  • Swiping between Spaces with a textured theme repaints the paper grain 240 → 2 times over a 120-frame swipe, and tabs with a custom symbol icon no longer rebuild the sidebar on every update.
  • Deleting history entries no longer runs the icon cleanup when no visit is actually removed: about 198 ms → skipped on a 200,000-visit history.

Fixed

  • Clearing your history also removes the deleted pages from the iCloud sync journal and from the synced copies in iCloud. "All Time" and removing a profile also wipe the engine's own internal history files the next time Circa starts.
  • Icons from websites are checked more strictly before they are displayed, so a malicious page can no longer use an unusual image format to reach the system's image decoder.
  • Look-alike addresses in the command bar suggestions now show in their real form. An address that imitates another one with foreign letters (for example a Cyrillic "а" in place of a Latin "a") shows as xn--…. Normal international addresses such as münchen.de still display normally.
  • The app is signed with narrower system permissions: the main process now refuses to load code that is not signed by Circa, and only the engine processes that need it keep the exceptions.

Known limits

  • Deleting a time range or a single site does not yet clear the engine's internal history, only Circa's own.
  • After this update, the history database cannot be opened by older Circa versions.
Release permalink ↗
